backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Person, Achievement, Event, LockerBill, EquipmentItem, LockerDocument, DriveLink, UserProfile) and implementing CRUD operations with access control for a team management system with blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three image display fix requirements for Layout.tsx and Home.tsx, ensuring 'baja logo.jpg' and 'image page.jpg' load correctly with proper import syntax.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend components, hooks, and configuration files describing modals, cards, galleries, styling, and data fetching logic for the VVCEBAJA application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining motorsports-themed CSS variables for light and dark modes including racing red, carbon black, metallic silver, and other theme colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with document title 'VVCEBAJA' and root div for React application mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, team, achievements, events, and protected member locker sections, wrapped in ThemeProvider with dark mode default.
Card component displaying achievement details with image, title, date, description, and admin-only delete functionality using React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/AddAchievementMo: Modal form for adding achievements with title, date, description, and multiple image uploads with progress tracking using ExternalBlob for file handling.
frontend/src/components/AddBillModal.tsx: Modal dialog component for uploading bills with fields for title, amount, date, comments, and image file. Handles file upload with progress tracking using ExternalBlob and integrates with useAddBill hook.
frontend/src/components/AddDocumentModal: Modal dialog component for uploading documents with fields for title, description, tags, and file. Supports file upload with progress tracking and uses useAddDocument hook for backend integration.
frontend/src/components/AddDriveLinkModa: Modal dialog component for adding external drive links with title, URL, and description fields. Validates URLs and uses useAddDriveLink hook to persist links.
frontend/src/components/AddEquipmentModa: Modal dialog component for adding equipment entries with fields for name, quantity, unit price, purchase date, description, comments, and image. Handles image upload with progress tracking using ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/AddEventModal.ts: Modal dialog component for creating events with title, date, location, description, and multiple image uploads. Supports batch image upload with progress tracking and uses useAddEvent hook.
frontend/src/components/AddPhotoModal.ts: Modal dialog for uploading multiple photo files with progress tracking, using ExternalBlob for file handling and displaying upload percentage.
frontend/src/components/AddTeamMemberMod: Modal dialog for adding team members with name, Principal ID, role, contact info, and image upload fields, including upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/BillCard.tsx: Displays a bill with image, title, amount, date, author, and comments; includes download and admin-only delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/DocumentCard.tsx: Displays a document with title, description, tags, upload date, and author; provides download and admin-only delete actions.
frontend/src/components/DriveLinkCard.ts: Displays a drive link with title, description, date added, and author; includes external link opening and admin-only delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/EquipmentCard.ts: Displays equipment item with image, name, quantity, unit price, purchase date, and description; includes admin-only delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/EventCard.tsx: Displays an event with optional image, title, date, location, and description; includes admin-only delete for non-past events.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header containing logo, desktop/mobile navigation, login button, and footer. Provides responsive navigation for Home, Our Team, Achievements, Events, and Member Locker pages.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that toggles between login/logout states using Internet Identity. Handles authentication flow, clears query cache on logout, and displays loading state during authentication.
frontend/src/components/PhotoGallery.tsx: Grid-based photo gallery component that displays locker documents sorted by upload date. Opens a lightbox modal when photos are clicked.
frontend/src/components/PhotoLightbox.ts: Full-screen photo viewer with keyboard navigation, download functionality, and admin-only delete capability. Displays photo metadata and supports prev/next navigation through photo array.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without profiles to enter their name. Prevents dismissal until profile is created and saves profile with join date.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Route guard component that displays loading state during initialization and shows login prompt for unauthenticated users. Renders children only when user is authenticated.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberCard.t: Card component displaying team member details including image, name, role, and contact info. Includes admin-only delete functionality to remove team members.
frontend/src/components/UpcomingEventsPr: Displays the next 3 upcoming events in a compact card format with date, title, description, and location. Shows loading state and hides when no upcoming events exist.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: React Query hooks for managing achievements including fetching all achievements and mutations for adding, updating, and removing achievements with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on authentication state, initializing with identity when authenticated and invalidating dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvents.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing events: fetching all events, adding, updating, and removing events via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication with React context, providing login/logout functionality, identity management, and authentication status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerBills.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing locker bills: fetching all bills, adding new bills, and deleting bills via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerDocuments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing locker documents: fetching all documents, adding new documents, and deleting documents via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerDriveLinks.t: Provides React Query hooks for managing drive links: fetching all drive links, adding new links, and deleting links via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerEquipment.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing equipment items: fetching all equipment, adding new equipment, and deleting equipment via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for admin checks, user profiles, team members, and achievements with full CRUD operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTeamMembers.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing team members (people): fetching, adding, updating, and removing person records via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom motorsports-themed color variables for light and dark modes using HSL color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutTeam.tsx: Displays team members in a grid layout with admin controls to add/edit/remove members, showing loading states and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Displays a sortable list of team achievements with admin controls to add new achievements via a modal. Shows loading state and empty state with trophy icon when no achievements exist.
frontend/src/pages/Events.tsx: Displays events split into upcoming and past sections, sorted by date. Includes admin controls to add events and shows empty state when no events are scheduled.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page with hero section featuring team image and navigation cards linking to team, achievements, events, and member locker sections. Includes upcoming events preview component.
frontend/src/pages/LockerBills.tsx: Displays financial bills sorted by date with admin controls to add new bills. Includes back navigation to member locker and empty state handling.
frontend/src/pages/LockerDocuments.tsx: Shows team documents with search functionality filtering by title, description, or tags. Includes upload controls and displays documents sorted by upload date.
frontend/src/pages/LockerDriveLinks.tsx: Manages external storage drive links sorted by date added. Provides add link functionality and empty state with back navigation to member locker.
frontend/src/pages/LockerEquipment.tsx: Displays equipment inventory sorted by purchase date with controls to add new equipment. Includes back navigation and empty state handling.
frontend/src/pages/LockerPhotos.tsx: Displays a photo gallery page that filters documents tagged as photos/images, with upload functionality via AddPhotoModal and a back link to Member Locker.
frontend/src/pages/MemberLocker.tsx: Landing page for the Member Locker feature displaying a grid of navigation cards to Bills, Equipment, Documents, Photos, and Drive Links sections.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (racing-red, carbon-black, etc.), container settings, border radius variables, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking known issues with logo/cover image display and three feature requests to fix image loading in Layout.tsx and Home.tsx.
